description: Defined public aggregate metrics for the INSTAR Lab Record Room. A data owner must approve a definition and provide a sourced snapshot before publication.

metrics.label: Funding awarded
metrics.description: The value of publicly approved awards in the stated period and category.
metrics.grain: one category per non-overlapping reporting period
metrics.population: Publicly disclosed awards whose award date falls inside the observation period.
metrics.exclusions: This is not revenue, cash received, expenditure, a commitment, or an estimate of undisclosed awards.

metrics.label: Active research projects
metrics.description: The count of approved research projects active at the stated as-of date.
metrics.grain: one domain and status combination at one as-of date
metrics.population: Distinct public research projects with an approved active status at the as-of date.
metrics.exclusions: This is not a count of website pages, publications, people, proposals, or awards.

metrics.label: Completed research outputs
metrics.description: The count of approved research outputs completed in the stated period and type.
metrics.grain: one output type per non-overlapping reporting period
metrics.population: Distinct public research outputs marked complete during the observation period.
metrics.exclusions: This is not a count of routes, page views, downloads, citations, or outcomes.

metrics.label: Active institutional partnerships
metrics.description: The count of approved institutional partnerships active at the stated as-of date.
metrics.grain: one partnership category at one as-of date
metrics.population: Distinct public institutional partnerships with an approved active status at the as-of date.
metrics.exclusions: This is not a count of contacts, prospects, vendors, customers, or informal conversations.
